pattern: \b(registration fee|processing fee|training fee|security deposit|refundable deposit|pay(?:ment)? of|pay us|deposit of|fee of|laptop deposit|tool cost|onboarding charge)\b
title: Payment Demand Detected
detail: The offer demands or implies an upfront fee, deposit, or payment. Legitimate employers never charge candidates.
advice: Never send money to an employer or recruiter. Real companies bear all hiring, onboarding, and training expenses.

pattern: \b(within \d+ hours?|immediately|urgently|limited slots|act now|today only|last chance|offer expires in|respond before tonight)\b
title: High Urgency & Pressure Language
detail: The message uses artificial time pressure to prompt quick action before you can verify its legitimacy.
advice: Pause and independently verify the communication through the employer's official website or campus placement cell.

pattern: \b(guaranteed (job|placement|internship)|100% placement|no interview required|instant offer|direct selection|selected without interview)\b
title: Unusual Job Guarantee / No Interview
detail: The letter promises guaranteed outcomes or skips customary technical and behavioral interviews.
advice: Reputable organizations follow rigorous interview stages. Confirm the selection process with company HR.

pattern: \b(otp|one[- ]time password|upi pin|netbanking password|banking credentials|card cvv|atm pin)\b
title: Sensitive Financial Credential Request
detail: The communication asks for one-time passwords, PINs, or confidential financial credentials.
advice: Never share OTPs, PINs, passwords, or CVV codes under any circumstance.

pattern: \b(submit original (degree|certificate|marksheets?)|handover original|keep certificates in custody|retention of original)\b
title: Retention of Original Academic Certificates
detail: The employer demands custody of your original mark sheets or degrees, which is strictly prohibited by labor & education regulators.
advice: Never surrender original academic credentials. Legitimate employers only review photocopies or digital credentials.

title: Recruiter Using Free / Personal Email
detail: A free personal email address was found in the text rather than a corporate domain.
advice: Check whether correspondence originates from an authorized corporate email domain (e.g., name@company.com).

title: Generic Recipient Salutation
detail: The offer does not address you by your full name or reference your formal application requisition ID.
advice: Ensure the letter specifies your full name, position requisition ID, and verified hiring team details.

pattern: \b(crypto|cryptocurrency|gift card|wire transfer|western union|telegram|whatsapp group)\b.{0,60}\b(fee|deposit|payment|salary|task)\b|\b(fee|deposit|payment|salary|task)\b.{0,60}\b(crypto|cryptocurrency|gift card|wire transfer|telegram|whatsapp group)\b
title: Untraceable Payment / Messaging Channel
detail: Mentions cryptocurrency, gift cards, or conducting official business exclusively via Telegram/WhatsApp tasks.
advice: Corporate employment processes do not use anonymous cryptocurrency or task-based chat groups.

title: Payment Requested via UPI / QR Code
detail: The message asks you to pay through UPI, a QR code or a payment app. Recruiters never collect money from candidates this way.
advice: Do not scan QR codes or send UPI payments to anyone offering a job. Report the UPI ID to your bank and cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Recruitment via Telegram / WhatsApp
detail: The offer moves the hiring process to Telegram or WhatsApp instead of official company email or portals.
advice: Insist on communication from an official company email domain and verify the role on the company's careers page.

pattern: \b(like (?:and|&) subscribe|rate (?:products|hotels|apps|movies)|(?:daily|simple|online) tasks? (?:and|to) earn|prepaid tasks?|commission (?:per|on each) task|earn (?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s?\d[\d,]* (?:per|a|daily|every) (?:day|task|hour))\b
title: Task-Based Earning Scheme
detail: The 'job' pays for liking videos, rating products or completing paid tasks. These schemes usually ask for a 'prepaid task' deposit later.
advice: Genuine internships do not pay per like or per review. Stop engaging before you are asked to deposit money for a task.

title: Remote-Access Software Requested
detail: The message asks you to install remote-access software, which gives the sender control of your device and banking apps.
advice: Never install AnyDesk, TeamViewer or similar tools for a job process. Uninstall it if already installed and change your banking passwords.
